issue.unannotated: {n} images have no annotations (and no image class). Keep them if they are true background images; otherwise label them.
issue.fewAnnotations: {n} categories have fewer than {min} annotations, too few to learn: {names}
issue.imbalance: Class imbalance: "{most}" has {ratio}× as many annotations as "{least}". Label more of the rare class or weight classes in training.
issue.duplicates: {n} likely duplicate annotations (same image, same category, almost the same box)

issue.tiny: {n} annotations cover less than 0.01% of the image; check they are not misclicks
issue.rejected: {n} images were rejected and wait for fixes
issue.taskNotRotated: {n} annotations are not rotated boxes; OBB export uses their minimum-area rectangle
issue.taskNoKeypoints: {n} annotations have no keypoints and are left out of pose exports

issue.confirmedEmpty: {n} images were confirmed as empty (nothing to annotate) and are not counted as missing annotations.

health.classBalanceHint: Annotations per category (bar) and in how many images it appears.
health.boxSizesHint: COCO definition: small < 32×32 px, medium < 96×96, large ≥ 96×96. Many small objects: consider a larger training image size.
health.aspectRatioHint: Width : height. Very thin boxes may be mistakes, or a fit for rotated boxes.
health.heatmapHint: Where annotation centres fall in the image (normalised). If objects cluster in one area, use translate / flip augmentation.
health.memberTimeHint: Time with an image open in the annotator. After 3 minutes without mouse or keyboard input, nothing from the last input on counts (the idle 3 minutes are left out too); another tab pauses it as well. 'Last 7 days' and 'Last worked' only count sessions logged since this update.

exportAugment.title: Augmentation
exportAugment.off: No augmentation: only the original images and annotations.
exportAugment.copies: Extra versions of each training image:

hint.hflip: Mirror left-right; left / right keypoints swap
hint.rotate: A random small angle; the canvas grows so nothing is cut
hint.scale: Crop a random part and scale it back; mostly cut objects are removed
hint.color: Random brightness, contrast, saturation and hue
hint.exposure: Much darker or brighter (night, shade, backlight)
hint.gray: Black and white, for models used on grey or infrared cameras
hint.cutout: 1–4 grey patches; objects more than 60 % covered are not annotated
hint.motion: A streak in a random direction (moving object or camera)
hint.jpeg: Low-quality compression (blocks, smeared colours), like video frames

exportAugment.withImages: Each version applies a random mix of the ticked operations (at least one) and transforms the annotations with it; the export includes the images (COCO becomes a zip: images/ + json).
exportAugment.alsoValTest: Augment validation and test too (not usual)
exportAugment.alsoValTestWarning: Validation / test should look like real data; a picture's versions still stay in its part, but the scores then include artificial variations.
exportAugment.noSplitWarning: No split: every image is augmented. If you split later yourself, keep each picture and its versions in the same part; better split in the previous step.
exportAugment.yoloDefault: YOLO already does this while training; not really needed here
exportAugment.yoloArg: Or turn it on when training:

train.subtitle: Train YOLO models on the server GPU from a YOLO export; one at a time, the others wait. Trained models go to the Models page for pre-annotation.
train.downHint: Start it on the server with docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu.yml up -d --build (an annotator_trainer container). Trainings wait in the queue until it runs.
train.noExports: No export to train on yet: export YOLO from a dataset with "images in the zip".
train.noSplit: This export is not split: validation uses the training images, so scores look too good. Split when exporting.
train.fromModelHint: A model from the Models page (e.g. the last training) as the start, after adding data.

size.n: smallest and fastest, good to try first
size.x: largest and most accurate, slowest, most GPU memory

train.name: Name (optional)
train.paramsHint: Patience: stop early after this many epochs without improvement. Out of GPU memory: lower batch or image size.
train.stopConfirm: Stop this training? The best weights so far still go to the Models page, and it can be resumed later.
train.removeConfirm: Remove training #{id}? (A model saved to the Models page stays)
train.kindPtHint: Starts from the official weights (trained on COCO and others); usually best with little data.
train.kindYamlHint: Architecture only, random weights: needs more data and epochs. You may load pretrained weights into it.
train.noModelsForTask: This family has no {task} models; choose another one.
train.uploadHint: .pt: your own weights (e.g. trained elsewhere). .yaml: an Ultralytics model architecture (with backbone and head); n/s/m/l/x in the file name (e.g. my-yolo26s.yaml) picks that scale.
train.advancedHint: Every Ultralytics training argument with its default; only changed ones (blue) are used, empty = default. data, model, project and the like are set by the server. An args.yaml can fill them in.

hint.mAP50-95: mean over IoU 0.5–0.95, the usual score

best.label: Best: epoch {epoch}
best.title: best.pt holds epoch {epoch}
best.saved: this epoch is the model saved to the Models page (best.pt)
best.howHint: Ultralytics picks best.pt by this score (fitness); segmentation / pose add up the box and mask / keypoint scores

train.downloadHint: Everything in runs/train: weights/best.pt, last.pt, results.csv, args.yaml, plots (confusion matrix, PR curves, batch samples) and the output

servers.title: Training servers
servers.intro: Let other servers on the network train with their GPU: add one here, get its token, and run the commands below on it. It takes trainings meant for it (or for any trainer) and sends the results back here.
servers.name: Name
servers.offlineHint: this trainer is not reporting (not running or unreachable)
servers.newTokenConfirm: Make a new token for "{name}"? The old one stops working at once; put the new one on that server.
servers.removeConfirm: Remove "{name}"? It can no longer train; queued trainings meant for it go to any trainer.
servers.tokenOnce: The token is shown only this once: copy it now.
servers.setupHint: TRAINER_URL is how that server reaches this site (internal IP:5000); change it if different.
servers.onOther: on {name} (needs Docker and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit)
servers.any: any free trainer (whichever is free first)
servers.gpuElsewhereHint: This GPU is used by something outside this site (e.g. a training run directly on that computer): queued trainings wait until it is free

train.reuseHint: Fill the new training above with this one's model, epochs, imgsz, batch, patience, advanced arguments and server, to change as you like
train.reuseNoExport: export #{id} is gone: pick an export

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.warning: This is the server's command line: once logged in you can do anything on the server, so take care. Every login is in the activity log.
terminal.notStored: The account and password are only used to log in this once, never stored.
terminal.copyHint: Select text to copy; Ctrl+Shift+V pastes

error.permission: You may not use the terminal

closed.lost: Lost the connection to the site; the terminal closed

trainAug.title: Augmentation
trainAug.trainWhat: (Ultralytics, at random each epoch, nothing saved)
trainAug.closeMosaic: Mosaic off for the last {n} epochs (close_mosaic), so the model sees normal images.
trainAug.unknown: The trainer has not reported Ultralytics' defaults yet.
trainAug.overlap: Done at export and again while training: {list} (they add up; set the training one to 0 in Advanced arguments to avoid it).
trainAug.editHint: Click an augmentation to change its value in Advanced arguments.

hint.optimizer: optimizer; auto picks one and ignores lr0
hint.warmup_epochs: warm-up epochs, learning rate rises to lr0
hint.nbs: nominal batch size, scales weight decay
hint.close_mosaic: no mosaic for the last epochs
hint.multi_scale: multi-scale: random image size range per batch
hint.overlap_mask: merge masks into one while training
hint.cache: cache images in RAM (ram) or on disk (disk) for speed
hint.fraction: use part of the training data (0–1)
hint.freeze: freeze the first N layers (e.g. 10) or [0, 1]
hint.save_period: also save weights every N epochs (-1 off)
hint.save_json: save validation results as COCO JSON
